question: Why can a chatbot answer the same prompt differently even with its randomness turned fully off?
answer: Because of other people's requests. Servers run many users' prompts together, and the batch size changes the order in which chips add up numbers; sums rounded in a different order differ in the last digits, and one changed word-piece alters everything after it. In 2025 researchers showed that batch-independent arithmetic makes answers repeat exactly.
move: Two runs of the same thing can differ because of what ran beside them.
reference: He & Thinking Machines Lab, Defeating Nondeterminism in LLM Inference, Connectionism, 2025
